<mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>押<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>达<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark>（“<ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby>”就是“<ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby>”，<ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby>母耳<ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>16<ruby>章<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhānɡ</rt></ruby>9<ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby>），

<ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>坦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby></mark>，

<ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn">阿<ruby>鲜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>姐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>妹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>鲁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>该<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāi</rt></ruby></mark>。<mark class="pn"><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>鲁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>筛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāi</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>押<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēi</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>共<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>该<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yì</rt></ruby><ruby>帖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiē</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>斯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>仑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn">阿<ruby>苏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>略<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lüè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn">阿<ruby>苏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>朔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuò</rt></ruby><ruby>罢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bà</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>押<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yā</rt></ruby><ruby>墩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dūn</rt></ruby></mark>。
verses.heading: 希斯仑的后裔

verses.text: <mark class="pn">阿<ruby>苏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hù</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hù</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>乌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wū</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>乌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wū</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>斯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>仑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>岁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suì</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>吉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>吉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>割<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby></mark>；

<mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>割<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>睚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yá</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark>。<mark class="pn"><ruby>睚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yá</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>邑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>述<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>睚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yá</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>邑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>纳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>乡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>村<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cūn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>共<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>吉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>斯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>仑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>提<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tí</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>斯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>仑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>篾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lán</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>布<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn">阿<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn">阿<ruby>鲜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark>。
verses.heading: 耶拉篾的后裔

verses.text: <mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>篾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby>她<ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn">阿<ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>篾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>兰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>斯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ā</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>买<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎi</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark>。<mark class="pn"><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>买<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>述<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>述<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby></mark>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>办<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>遍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>遍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>珊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>珊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>买<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yì</rt></ruby><ruby>帖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiē</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>单<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>益<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yì</rt></ruby><ruby>帖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiē</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>单<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>萨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sà</rt></ruby></mark>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>篾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>珊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>。<mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>珊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hā</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn">埃<ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>珊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>单<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>单<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>拔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bá</rt></ruby></mark>；

<mark class="pn">俄<ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark>；

<mark class="pn"><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>龙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lónɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>篾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>弗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>祖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>仑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>祖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 迦勒的其余后裔

<mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>缅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ní</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>悯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>扫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby></mark>。

verses.text: <mark class="pn"><ruby>扫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>龙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lónɡ</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>龙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lónɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>衫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>衫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark>；

<mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hā</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hā</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby></mark>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>族<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>丁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>增<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>缅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bié</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hā</rt></ruby><ruby>萨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sà</rt></ruby><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark>、

<mark class="pn"><ruby>辟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pì</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>森<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sēn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>陀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tuó</rt></ruby><ruby>腊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">là</rt></ruby></mark>、

<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hé</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>革<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡé</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby></mark>、

<mark class="pn"><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bó</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>嘉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>博<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hā</rt></ruby><ruby>萨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sà</rt></ruby><ruby>苏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bó</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>邑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>缅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>邑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lín</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>陀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tuó</rt></ruby><ruby>健<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>珊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark>；

<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hái</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>米<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby></mark>、

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>珥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby></mark>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>莱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>莱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby><ruby>薛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuē</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hái</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>朔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuò</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>帅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuài</rt></ruby><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>篾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby>拿<ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎ</rt></ruby></mark>、
